test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ZERO is coded as 64, and FIVE is coded as 42. How will ELEVEN be coded in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72d7fc5abd4945076a694d4019518860884115a8e887df4f469471b5a28d818a.png] 

**Logic:** 'Addition of the positional values of the letters'

ZERO is coded as 64 →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ddb5040a00765a5857f5ce9d807faf83be77d360717004799cafd22619a659c.png] 

FIVE is coded as 42 →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6e570b6a4804c4f3ebd298534bfb6f34a96d51abc7cdee542993c54a426fdb1.png] 

Similarly, 'ELEVEN' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a75352d594f96023502f74029d6aa84b282e330019cc5ddb51fca46b05aeded.png] 

Here, 'ELEVEN' is coded as **63.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
